notes: Verified against EIZO's own product page (eizo.com) and EIZO's official "Technical Data" datasheet PDF (authored/copyrighted by EIZO Europe GmbH, mirrored by reseller dpsb.co.uk after the primary eizo.es/eizo.de PDF links returned 404 and eizoglobal.com failed TLS verification). No DVI, SDI, audio, or LAN ports exist on this model — it is video-input-only (DisplayPort x2, HDMI x2) plus a USB 3.1 Gen1/5Gbps hub (1x Type-B upstream, 3x Type-A downstream, one with 10.5W charging). DisplayPort version (1.2) is explicitly stated in EIZO's own datasheet feature bullets ("Two 1.2 DisplayPorts"); HDMI version is NOT explicitly stated by EIZO on any page checked (only HDCP 1.4/2.2 and Deep Color are specified), so no HDMI grade was set even though third-party retailer aggregations commonly list it as HDMI 2.0 — that figure could not be confirmed on an authoritative EIZO page. Power consumption: 52W typical, 140W max, 1.2W standby. Desktop monitor — no rack units. No physical port labels/numbers appear on the rear panel photo (just grouped "USB" / "HDMI" / "DisplayPort" silkscreen), so the "1"/"2"/"3" suffixes above are for disambiguation only, not printed labels.

ports.name: DisplayPort 1
ports.note: HDCP 1.3; supports DCI 4K 60p, up to 10-bit 4:4:4 at 50/60p

ports.name: DisplayPort 2
ports.note: HDCP 1.3; supports DCI 4K 60p, up to 10-bit 4:4:4 at 50/60p

ports.name: HDMI 1
ports.note: Deep Color, HDCP 1.4/2.2; supports DCI 4K 60p, 12-bit 4:2:2 at 50/60p. HDMI protocol version (widely reported elsewhere as 2.0) is not stated by EIZO, so no grade is set.

ports.name: HDMI 2
ports.note: Deep Color, HDCP 1.4/2.2; supports DCI 4K 60p, 12-bit 4:2:2 at 50/60p. HDMI protocol version not stated by EIZO, so no grade is set.

ports.name: USB Upstream (Type B)
ports.note: Connects to host PC to feed the built-in 3-port USB hub; USB 3.1 Gen 1 / 5Gbps per EIZO technical data sheet

ports.name: USB Downstream (Type A) 1
ports.note: One of 3 downstream Type-A hub ports; USB 3.1 Gen 1 / 5Gbps. One of the three supports Battery Charging up to 10.5W.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: AC 100-120V/200-240V, 50/60Hz; ships with a detachable power cord (listed in box contents), so treated as a standard IEC inlet — EIZO's own spec sheet does not print the exact IEC connector letter (e.g. C13/C14).
